West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee Attacked During Durga Puja Event

West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee's sari was pulled by a young woman during the inauguration of a Durga Puja pandal in Kalighat, Kolkata. The assailant reportedly brought a weapon concealed in her sari. MP Dola Sen has filed a complaint regarding the incident, raising questions about security. Banerjee had returned to Kolkata after an agitation in Delhi.
